snippet.title: Personal Agents, Clearly Explained
snippet.description:
📧 Join my free AI Essentials newsletter - https://www.jeffsu.org/newsletter/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=v212

Already using #ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and wondering whether personal AI agents are worth your time? A chatbot can summarize one health report, a do-it-yourself agent can compare it with your history, and personal agents like #Muse, Dots, and Grok Bot can offer help before you ask.

The difference is how much your AI remembers and how much work you need to do. Personal Agents are easier to start using, while your own #AI Workspace gives you more control and memory files you can move between tools. Your choice also depends on privacy and ecosystem lock-in.

snippet.title: Stop Organizing Files Yourself.
snippet.description:
📦 Try Dropbox in ChatGPT with your team: https://bit.ly/jeffsudropbox 

Every downloaded PDF becomes another file to rename and another folder to choose. In this video, I show you how to give #AI a file management rulebook so it can name and organize your files using the folder structure and preferences that make sense to you.

Specifically, you’ll see my exact setup in #ChatGPT Work (applicable to both Claude and Gemini Spark) and how to create a system that reorganizes your existing Google Drive files. Then we'll schedule a daily task that uses the same rulebook to help keep new files organized.

Thanks to Dropbox for sponsoring this video! For my YouTube production workflow, I use Dropbox in ChatGPT to organize new footage according to my handoff rules, review the proposed changes, and create one Dropbox folder link so my editor has everything ready to edit.
